title: Dick and Vallée precognize each other's work: VALIS and The Invisible College

tellings.quote: other's work they were both writing uh in 1974 1975 that's when uh valet was writing the invisible college and that's when dick was writing the first draft of what became veis

plain: The science fiction writer Philip K. Dick and the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée each seemed to sense the other's work before seeing it, says the researcher Eric Wargo, who tells it as his own summary without naming a source. He says that in 1974 and 1975 Vallée was writing The Invisible College, his book on UFO contact, published in 1975, while Dick was writing the first draft of what became VALIS, his novel about a divine signal, published in 1981, an early version of which was the novel Radio Free Albemuth. If true, Wargo suggests, it would be a case of two writers picking up each other's ideas ahead of time.
